provenance.bootstrap_unit: run (the windows of a run are resampled together)

definitions.detection: window-level; every label but NORMAL is ANOMALY (ml/job/detection.py). fpr counts any flagged NORMAL window; fpr_healthy only windows with no fault active; fault_start_flagged the NORMAL fault-start minutes flagged (faults caught early, which the labels count as false positives).
definitions.deployed: the live path's rule applied offline to the stored labeled windows: the forest flags the window AND the classifier names a fault. Window-level, so not a count of live incidents, and a yes/no with no score, so it has no ROC AUC.
definitions.latency: per incident run, from the fault's onset to the end of the first flagged labeled anomalous window; missed runs are counted apart and left out of the median.
definitions.classification: labeled windows only, six-class; macro-F1 over classes in the truth or the predictions.
definitions.per_band: standard-length (300s) single-fault test runs; recall on the fault's windows; flagged when more than 10 percentage points below its reference.
definitions.confounder_windows: labeled non-NORMAL windows with multi_fault_ms >= 30000 (both faults active).
